summary: Visa Helper v2 (AI Recommender + Bundle History) end-to-end tested. Backend: 12/12 new v2 pytest tests pass + 23/23 v1 regression tests pass (35/35 total). All required v2 endpoints verified: countries de-duplicated to exactly 6, pathways catalog expanded to >=16 (all required IDs across AU/US/JP/SG/BE/EU present with enrichment fields populated), entities=6, /api/visa/admin/cleanup-duplicates works for super-admin and 403s for franchise, /api/visa/recommend returns top=5 + all>=9 with correct suitability/reasons/risks/country structure (rule-only ~1s; with AI narrative ~31s and ai_rationale populated on top-3), /api/visa/application/VA-3F0A0162DD/build-complete-bundle returns valid ZIP (>5KB, application/zip, X-Bundle-Id header set, contains 01_Visa_Readiness_Report.pdf + 02_Letter_Checklist.xlsx + 03_Letters/*.docx + 99_manifest.txt), /api/visa/admin/bundles lists the new bundle with kind='complete', /api/visa/admin/bundle/{id} downloads the ZIP for super-admin and 403s for franchise. Frontend: /visa-helper opens with 'AI Recommender' as the DEFAULT ACTIVE tab. 4 tabs visible (AI Recommender [active], Applications, Manual Wizard, Admin Panel). Recommender form has all required fields (applicant_name, current_role, age*, years_of_experience, nationality, english_status, shareholding_pct, goal), 6 unique country pills (rec-country-AU/BE/EU/JP/SG/US), and 8 toggles (family, existing ops, expansion plan, business plan, financial proof, franchise letter, skills assessment, AI narrative). Submitting Sandeep profile (AI narrative OFF, AU+US shortlist) rendered the 'Recommendations' section with 5 result cards each showing pathway name, country flag, suitability badge (Strong 100/100), timeline, company/applicant cost bands, Why bullets, Risk bullets, and 'Proceed with this visa' button. Clicking 'Proceed' on the top card switched the active tab to 'Manual Wizard' and prefilled Sandeep's snapshot (name, age=42, nationality=Indian, marital=Married, location=Pune, India) with a success toast 'Loaded L-1A Intra-Company Transferee (Executive/Manager) into the Manual Wizard for refinement'.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend visa-tab-recommender hydration on 'Proceed with this visa' correctly switches tab and seeds wizard with applicant snapshot AND selected country (verified by toast + Step 2 prefill).

AI Recommender 'rule-only' path is extremely fast (<1s) and returns deterministic ranked output — good UX. AI narrative path takes ~30s for 3 letters which is acceptable but should show a clear loading indicator.
build-complete-bundle on an app with pre-drafted letters completes in <15s as documented. Bundle persistence to /app/backend/visa_bundles/ confirmed via admin list+download endpoints.

visa.py file is now ~2000 lines per spec — recommend continuing the previous suggestion to split into routes/visa_admin.py, routes/visa_application.py, routes/visa_exports.py, routes/visa_recommender.py for maintainability.
